title: chat-filenode: manage_channels cannot delete files in tree root
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 #permissions withholds mayDelete/mayRename on the tree root below manage_space. Under filenode-19 Files directly in the root take the root's myRights, so manage_channels members cannot delete, rename or move top-level files, contrary to the table's intent.
close_reason: Fixed permission table and root rules in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 #permissions to match filenode-19 rights model
